name: com.booknewsletterads/catalog
title: Book Newsletter Ads
description: Search public newsletter ad prices and send an inquiry. No account required.

tools.name: search_newsletters
tools.description:
Search the public newsletter sponsorship catalog.

    Returns id, name, a short description, audience, subscribers, language, countries,
    categories, ad types, the USD price range, and the page URL on booknewsletterads.com.
    Hidden and opted-out newsletters are not included. Publisher emails, phone numbers,
    and contact names are not included. Prices are the publisher's public list prices in USD.
    An inquiry is how an advertiser asks about a placement: call send_inquiry. We pass it
    to the publisher, who replies to the advertiser directly.

keyword.description: Words matched against the public name, description, audience, categories, and tags. Every word must match. Leave empty to browse.
keyword.title: Keyword

category.description: Exact category from list_categories, for example Finance & CFO or Developer & Engineering.
category.title: Category

niche.description: Substring matched against categories, tags, and who the newsletter is relevant for.
niche.title: Niche

language.description: Language from list_categories, for example English or German.
language.title: Language

audience_country.description: 2-letter audience country code or GLOBAL, from list_categories.
audience_country.title: Audience Country

publisher_country.description: 2-letter publisher country code or GLOBAL, from list_categories.
publisher_country.title: Publisher Country

ad_type.description: Primary (also called header), Mid, Dedicated (also called full-send), Classified, or Unknown.
ad_type.title: Ad Type

price_min.description: Minimum list price in USD for the matching offer.
price_min.title: Price Min

price_max.description: Maximum list price in USD for the matching offer.
price_max.title: Price Max

subscribers_min.description: Minimum subscriber count. Newsletters with no public count are excluded when this is set.
subscribers_min.title: Subscribers Min

subscribers_max.description: Maximum subscriber count. Newsletters with no public count are excluded when this is set.
subscribers_max.title: Subscribers Max

sort.description: auto (relevance when a keyword is set, otherwise name), name, price_asc, price_desc, subscribers, or relevance.
sort.title: Sort

tools.name: get_newsletter
tools.description:
Full public details and ad offers for one newsletter.

    Includes each offer's name, ad type, list price in USD, issue count, unit, and any public
    specs, plus the newsletter page on booknewsletterads.com. Use an offer id with send_inquiry.
    Publisher contact details are not part of this catalog. To ask about a placement, send an
    inquiry through this server. We pass it to the publisher, who replies to the advertiser directly.

newsletter.description: Newsletter id from search_newsletters, or the exact public name.
newsletter.title: Newsletter

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description:
List the categories, languages, ad types, and countries actually in the public catalog.

    Counts are newsletters, not offers. Use the names and codes as search_newsletters filters.
    Ad types: Primary is the header or lead slot, Mid is inside the issue, Dedicated is a full send,
    Classified is a short text listing.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description:
Send an advertiser inquiry for one public newsletter offer.

    This creates the same lead the website inquiry form creates. An admin then passes it to the
    publisher, who replies to the advertiser directly with availability and booking. We do not
    take payment and we do not confirm the placement. No account is required. Identical inquiries
    from the same email within 24 hours return the existing reference instead of a second lead.
    The lead is marked source mcp so admin can filter it.

advertiser_email.description: Work email the publisher can reply to. Required. Disposable inboxes are rejected.
advertiser_email.title: Advertiser Email

newsletter.description: Newsletter id or exact name from search_newsletters. Required.
newsletter.title: Newsletter

message.description: What is being advertised, and any brief for the publisher. At least 20 characters. Required.
message.title: Message

accept_terms.description: Must be true only after the advertiser agrees that Book Newsletter Ads passes their name, email, and message to the publisher so the publisher can reply directly.
accept_terms.title: Accept Terms

offer.description: Offer id, or an ad type (Primary, Mid, Dedicated, Classified, header, full-send). Omit to use the newsletter's default offer.
offer.title: Offer

website.description: Advertiser site or landing page, https address. Optional.
website.title: Website

budget.description: Budget note, for example 1500 USD. Optional. Not a payment.
budget.title: Budget

dates.description: Preferred send window, for example the week of 1 March. Optional.
dates.title: Dates
